title: From Prefix Cache to Fusion RAG Cache: Accelerating LLM Inference in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Jiahao Wang; Weiyu Xie; Mingxing Zhang; Boxing Zhang; Jianwei Dong; Yuening Zhu; Chen Lin; Jinqi Tang; Yaochen Han; Zhiyuan Ai; Xianglin Chen; Yongwei Wu; Congfeng Jiang
venue_full: Proceedings of the ACM on Management of Data (SIGMOD 2026)
affiliations: Hangzhou Dianzi University, Tsinghua University, Approaching.AI

problem_statement.en: RAG appends retrieved chunks to prompts, making prefill dominate end-to-end latency (95.53% of inference time on Musique). Chunk-wise KVCache reuse (Full Reuse) discards cross-attention between chunks and severely degrades generation quality, while existing selective-recomputation methods (CacheBlend, Cache-Craft) fail to restore quality at low recomputation ratios.
problem_statement.zh: RAG 將檢索到的 text chunk 附加至 prompt，使 prefill 主導端到端延遲（在 Musique 上占推理時間的 95.53%）。以 chunk 為單位的 KVCache 重用（Full Reuse）喪失 chunk 之間的 cross-attention，導致生成品質顯著下降；既有的選擇性重算方法（CacheBlend、Cache-Craft）在低重算比例下亦難以恢復品質。

key_innovation.en: FusionRAG optimizes both stages of two-stage RAG caching: offline Similarity-Guided Preliminary Cross-attention Preprocessing embeds information from each chunk's top-n most similar chunks into its cached KV, while online Query-Guided Selection picks critical tokens via the model's own query-key attention instead of position-biased KV deviation. System support includes Alternative Path prefix-cache matching (one KVCache replica per chunk), an asynchronous KVCache scheduler over a disk-CPU-GPU hierarchy, and the Q-Sparse-Attn Triton kernel for batched sparse recomputation.
key_innovation.zh: FusionRAG 同時優化 two-stage RAG cache 的兩個階段：離線階段以 Similarity-Guided Preliminary Cross-attention Preprocessing 將每個 chunk 的 top-n 相似 chunk 資訊嵌入其快取 KV；線上階段以 Query-Guided Selection 依模型自身的 query-key attention（而非受位置偏差影響的 KV deviation）挑選關鍵 token。系統層面則提供 Alternative Path prefix cache 匹配（每個 chunk 僅保留一份 KVCache 副本）、跨 disk-CPU-GPU 階層的非同步 KVCache scheduler，以及支援批次稀疏重算的 Q-Sparse-Attn Triton kernel。

baselines_compared: Full Attention, Full Reuse, CacheBlend, Cache-Craft, FlashAttention, SDPA

key_improvements.en: By recomputing fewer than 15% of tokens, achieves up to 70% higher Normalized-F1 than CacheBlend/Cache-Craft; reduces TTFT by 2.66-9.39x versus Full Attention; delivers 1.2-4.3x throughput in multi-question serving.
key_improvements.zh: 在重算不到 15% token 的情況下，Normalized-F1 較 CacheBlend/Cache-Craft 最高提升 70%；TTFT 較 Full Attention 降低 2.66-9.39x；多問題服務情境下吞吐量提升 1.2-4.3x。
